## Referências básicas

- Faraway, J. J. (2014). [Linear Model with R (2nd Ed.)](https://wangyang-bucket.oss-cn-beijing.aliyuncs.com/cms/image/Linear%20Models%20With%20R_1676789263894.pdf). ChapmanHall/CRC. [**Ebook**]

- Faraway, J. J. (2016). [Extending the Linear Model with R (2nd Ed.)](https://englianhu.wordpress.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/01/faraway-extending-the-linear-model-with-r-e28093-2006.pdf). ChapmanHall/CRC. [**Ebook**]

- Wood, S. N. (2017). [Generalized Additive Models: An Introduction with R (2nd Ed.)](https://www.taylorfrancis.com/books/mono/10.1201/9781315370279/generalized-additive-models-simon-wood). Chapman and Hall/CRC.

- Zuur, A.F., et al. (2009). [Mixed effects models and extensions in ecology with R](https://link.springer.com/book/10.1007/978-0-387-87458-6). Springer.
